title: Lab - Services
description: Expose a Deployment three ways and test each from inside and outside the cluster.
scenario: Expose a Deployment three ways and test each from inside and outside the cluster. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - ClusterIP
tasks.instructions: Expose Deployment api on port 80 as a ClusterIP Service and curl it from a temporary Pod.
tasks.solution:
kubectl expose deployment api --port=80
kubectl run tmp --rm -it --image=busybox -- wget -qO- api

tasks.title: Task 2 - NodePort
tasks.instructions: Create a NodePort Service for the same Deployment on node port 30080.
tasks.solution:
kubectl expose deployment api --name=api-np --type=NodePort --port=80 --dry-run=client -o yaml > np.yaml
# set nodePort: 30080 under ports, then
kubectl apply -f np.yaml

tasks.title: Task 3 - Endpoints
tasks.instructions: Show which Pod IPs the Service forwards to.
tasks.verification: kubectl get pods -l app=api -o wide  # same IPs
